card: This pull request opts eight functional tests that do not test relay timing into immediate transaction relay using the noban_tx_relay flag and ensures the whitelist survives node restarts. Transaction relay to inbound peers is delayed by a Poisson process, leading to intermittent CI timeouts tracked in issue #19732. The author reports that under a forced-delay reproducer, runtime across affected tests dropped from ~60-75 seconds down to 3-14 seconds while eliminating timeouts. It touches only functional tests and has no open PR dependencies.
evidence: Addresses 8 of 14 flaky tests listed in issue #19732 (qa: Functional tests are intrinsically vulnerable to timeouts).

Author reports that under a 12-minute forced delay reproducer, changed tests reliably pass and execution times drop substantially (e.g., wallet_change_address drops from 62 s to 3 s, wallet_balance from 66 s to 6 s, rpc_psbt from 74 s to 14 s).
problem: Functional tests that do not deliberately test relay timing can time out intermittently because transaction relay to inbound peers is delayed by a Poisson process. Additionally, several tests dropped the whitelist argument on node restarts, inadvertently re-introducing the delay.

risk.why: A mistake can only cause functional test failures or mask relay timing behavior in tests.

scope_notes: Small test-only change modifying 9 test files to set an existing test framework flag or preserve extra args across restarts.
summary: Opts seven functional tests into immediate transaction relay by setting `noban_tx_relay = True`, which whitelists the local peer and bypasses Poisson transaction relay delays. It also updates three tests so node restarts retain whitelist flags from `self.extra_args` rather than overriding them with literal argument lists.
